description: Starts one round of the Awwab Knowledge quiz on Islam: five questions in the chosen language, on an optional topic such as the prophets, the Qur'an, the Prophet's life, worship or Islamic history. Use this for a request for an Islamic quiz, test or trivia. Returns the questions and their options without the correct answers, and a quiz_id for check_answer. Question types: multiple_choice, true_false, fill_blank and match_pairs.

language.description: Language of the questions, options and explanations. Default en.

topic.description: Optional topic, e.g. "the prophets", "Ramadan", "Yusuf". Without one the round is mixed.

name: start_quiz

available_topics.description: Present when a topic was asked for and none matched

questions.description: id, number, type, difficulty, prompt, and template, options or lefts and rights by type. No answers.

topic.description: The matched topic's name, or null for a mixed round

title: Start an Awwab quiz
